research_question: Does any pair of distinct mutually exclusive outcomes inside the three retained fixed-NegRisk September 30 events have a side-specific NO acquisition cost strictly below its one-pUSD payout floor and remain positive after one adverse tick per leg plus exact configured taker fees?

payoff_identity: Within one fixed-NegRisk event, any two distinct outcomes are mutually exclusive. NO(A) plus NO(B) therefore pays one pUSD when A or B occurs and two pUSD when another outcome occurs, for a one-pUSD floor independent of market direction.
price_gate: Use direct NO bestAsk when available or conservative one minus direct YES bestBid. Gamma is rejection-only and may not accept or promote an edge. Missing side-specific acquisition evidence is not a free leg.
stress_gate: A pair may advance only when the common minimum executable quantity remains strictly positive after one adverse configured tick on each leg and the exact per-market configured taker fee model.
selection_rule: Enumerate every unordered pair within all three frozen events, rank priced rows by ascending unstressed acquisition cost then event ID and market IDs, and never select a sibling after a later exact-depth failure without a literal new trigger.
prohibited_shortcuts: do not refetch reprice paginate alias or request a book before the retained screen passes every frozen gate
do not use outcomePrices midpoints last trades missing asks or future prices as acquisition evidence
do not omit an expensive pair or select a pair after viewing economics
